author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸತ್ಯಶೋಧನೆಗಾಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತಗಳಿಹವಿಲ್ಲಿ
ನಿತ್ಯಸಾಧನೆಯಿಹವು ನಿಜವನರಿವುದಕೆ
ವತ್ಯ ಚಿಂತನೆಯಿಂದ ತಿಳಿಯೆ ಸತ್ಯದ ದಾರಿ
ಮಿಥ್ಯೆಗಳ ಮಥಿಸುತಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

(ವತ್ಯ ಪದದ ಅರ್ಥ:ಉದಾತ್ತ, ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ)

lines: There are philosophies here for the search for truth;
there are daily practices for knowing what is real;
if you know the path of truth through noble thinking,
keep churning the falsehoods, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Many schools of thought and daily disciplines exist to help us find the truth. Think nobly, and keep sifting and discarding what is false.
en.note: Kusha’s own gloss: vatya means noble, an excellent person.
